_meta.platform: four party caucus sites (no per-member .gov pressrooms)
_meta.status: DRAFT — not registered in pipeline/lib/seeds.py or the daily cron
_meta.roster_source: Caucus member directories. iga.in.gov is a React SPA whose api.iga.in.gov backend requires an API key, so the roster is assembled from the four caucus directories instead.
_meta.attribution_model: Caucus-hosted but per-member attributable. Every one of the 150 members has a distinct per-member press listing URL on their caucus site, so records attribute to an individual legislator, not to the caucus. Joint releases (e.g. 'Hamilton County legislators: ...') appear on every named member's listing and will duplicate across members — dedupe on source_url.

parser_families.in_senate_r_member: indianasenaterepublicans.com/{slug}. Listing at div.module-item div.media-body, title in h4.media-heading a. No date in the listing — date comes from the 'STATEHOUSE (Mon. D, YYYY)' dateline on the detail page, so this family costs one extra fetch per item. No pagination; the member page carries the member's full archive.
parser_families.in_senate_d_taxonomy_rss: WordPress. Per-member taxonomy archive at indianasenatedemocrats.org/caucus/{slug}/ with a working RSS feed at .../feed/ (and ?paged=N). wp-json is 401-locked. Deeper history via the HTML archive at .../page/N/.
parser_families.in_house_r_member: Accrisoft. indianahouserepublicans.com/members/{group}/{slug}/ renders the member's entire archive on one page: div.media-body with h3.sub-heading a, date in p.meta strong, author in p.meta em. content_type is encoded in the article path segment (press-releases | guest-column | photo-caption). Article hrefs are root-relative despite rendering bare.
parser_families.in_house_d_squarespace_json: Squarespace. indianahousedemocrats.org/news/category/{category} with ?format=json. 12 items per page, cursor pagination via pagination.nextPageUrl. publishOn is epoch milliseconds.

_meta.notes: Indiana legislators have no individual .gov websites. All press output runs through the four party caucus sites, each on a different CMS. Verified live 2026-07-25: 150/150 members resolved to a working per-member press URL. No Akamai/Cloudflare blocking observed on any of the four sites; plain hardened httpx works. Gotcha: the Senate Democrats' own senator page links to /caucus/la-keisha-jackson (404) — the working tag slug is /caucus/jackson/.
